items.prompt: True or false: From 9:15 to 10:00 is 45 minutes.
hints: Count up to the next hour.
9:15 to 10:00 is the rest of the hour.
items.explanation: From 9:15 to 10:00: 15 minutes to 9:30, then 15 to 9:45, then 15 to 10:00. That is 45 minutes.

items.prompt: True or false: April has 31 days.
hints: Use the knuckle rule or the rhyme.
April is one of the shorter months.
items.explanation: April has 30 days. The rhyme says thirty days has September, April, June and November.
